column1: # ecalc/switches_review.tsv -- hand-written (T27, 2026-10-12): owner and review date of every setting that is not a plain default:
# experiments, diagnostics and test-harness switches, and the fallback values kept after a default flipped.  Read by
# tools/switch_registry.py (columns owner, review of ecalc/switches.tsv); its --check warns (never fails) on a past review
# date, on an experiment / test-only row without a review row, and on a review row whose switch is gone.
# Seed rule: experiments and fallbacks 30 days (2026-11-11); diagnostics and test harness 6 months (2027-04-12).
# At review: remove the switch (or its fallback value), or move the date with a reason in the note.
# columns (tab separated): name, class (experiment|fallback|diagnostic|test), owner, review (YYYY-MM-DD), note
